profile.name: Deep Podder
profile.headline: Backend and AI engineer building
profile.intro: Async FastAPI backends, vector search, and cloud-integrated data pipelines — designed for concurrency, then measured against real numbers.

projects.name: Career Guidance AI
projects.stack: FastAPI · pgvector · Groq · Gemini · React · Docker
points: Multi-stage resume parsing: pdfplumber with a Gemini Vision fallback, and semaphore-controlled asyncio.gather firing six parallel section-extraction prompts.
N+1 queries removed from the recommendation engine, plus a dual-layer embedding cache in front of Gemini.
51,000-line backend, 91 REST endpoints, 31 tables, a 106-test suite — blocking LLM and SSE calls offloaded to worker threads.

projects.name: Insurance Policy Document Handler
points: High-concurrency KYC portal: concurrent S3 presigned URL generation through asyncio.gather across a fully async stack (asyncpg, aioboto3).
Redis dashboard caching with SCAN-driven invalidation and composite indexes; SHA-256 duplicate blocking; five-year retention cleanup. 8,300 lines, 27 endpoints.

projects.name: JiraSync
points: Async ETL service replacing a fragile Appfire OData connector: a local Postgres warehouse, advisory locks to stop overlapping scheduler runs, and schema-drift alerts into Slack and Teams.
Jira API resilience built in — 10 req/s client-side pacing, five-attempt exponential backoff, JSONB field storage.

projects.name: YourPDF
projects.stack: Next.js · FastAPI · pypdf · Ghostscript · Tesseract · Docker · Cloud Run
points: Twenty-seven PDF, image and office tools behind one API — every job returns in the request that started it, with no queue and no polling.
Files are processed server-side and deleted immediately after the response; no accounts, no trackers, no stored output.
